policies.children: Children aged 4 to 14 pay the child price. For children under 4, please call us so we can check the tour is suitable.
policies.weather: Our skipper decides on weather and sea conditions by 6:00 pm the day before. If we cancel, you choose a full refund or a free change of date.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before departure. Inside 48 hours, please call us and a team member will help.
policies.stingers: Stinger suits are supplied free on reef tours. Stinger season is roughly November to May.
policies.payment: We send a secure payment link with your booking confirmation. We never ask for card details by email or phone.
